summary: Complete independent audit of all 183 Chinese units, 28 temporal/hint checks, and 11 people. 康熙十三年 records Nan Huairen’s 1674 catalog revision and supports the directly dated office/event records. The remaining imported ranges either turn a dynasty label into continuous personal activity or assign an author/cited catalog a date supplied only by retrospective context. Concrete date/hint repairs are required; all other nonapproved material is retained as source-specific research holds. No source or canonical extraction was changed.
